thread:
nina: Hey team — incoming customer request to onboard Waverider-14B for BlueHarbor. They want Dedicated/private deploy (VPC) with p95 latency <= 120ms for 512-token responses. High priority for them — legal approved, but they need a 4-bit quantization proof and a quick quality regression eval vs our current baseline (Lyra-11B). Can someone pick this up?

leo: @nina can you drop the model artifact/source? HF name or S3 path? Also any preferred tokenizer or was it the standard byte-level bpe? :eyes:

nina: HF repo: https://huggingface.co/blueharbor/waverider-14b (private) — we have short-term access. Tokenizer is standard bpe; no special tokens. I've uploaded a signed copy to s3://inbound-models/blueharbor/waverider-14b.tar.gz for infra.

alex: I can run quant experiments. Plan: baseline FP16 -> PTQ 8-bit -> GPTQ/4-bit (nf4). Quick commands I usually run:

```bash
# quick PTQ smoke
rwd-quantize --model s3://inbound-models/blueharbor/waverider-14b.tar.gz --out /tmp/wrv1 --mode ptq --bits 8
# try nf4 4-bit fallback
rwd-quantize --model /tmp/wrv1 --out /tmp/wrv1-nf4 --mode gptq --bits 4 --group-size 128
```

I'll add latency runs on p4d and a40 to compare. Need to know target batch sizes (p1) and perf SLOs for concurrency.

carmen: For Dedicated sizing: if we need p95 <= 120ms for 512 tokens, estimate (rough) — on A100-80GB single-socket might be tight for 14B at batch 1 without nf4. If nf4 works, A40 or T4 pool may be possible with proper batching/caching. Also need KV-cache memory numbers. Can you share expected RPS?

nina: They're expecting ~10 rps bursty (peak 25) but average ~4 rps. Mostly single-turn chat. Prefers low-cost config but will accept reserved capacity if metrics are good.

leo: Evals we should run (quick set):
- LAMBADA (generation) for basic capability
- TruthfulQA (safety/hallucinations)
- BlueHarbor internal prompt suite (they provided 120 prompts) - already in s3
- Rogue answer regression: run Lyra-11B baseline on same prompt set and compare F1/EM/avg length/hallucination flags

Also include a small sampling of safety/toxicity checks. We'll create a short eval dashboard.

alex: I'll do the quant + latency matrix and produce a small perf/cost table. Plan timeline: smoke quant + generate baseline evals today (<6h), full nf4 tuning + regression run tomorrow.

dmitri (ops-bot): Ticket created: INB-4521 — Waverider-14B onboarding. Owners: unassigned. Links: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INB-4521

carmen: One more infra ask: please include an estimate of disk for model variants (fp16, int8, nf4) and expected RAM for shard placement. I need those to size the Dedicated pool.

alex: Quick sizes after a probe (will confirm): fp16 ~28GB, int8 ~14GB, nf4 ~9-10GB. KV cache for 512 tokens ~ (14B) ~ about 4-6GB depending on shard. I'll attach numbers in the ticket.

nina: Checklist (from product side) to close onboarding:
1) Model artifact verified + license check (done)
2) Quantization experiments and perf matrix (owner: alex)
3) Regression eval vs Lyra-11B (owner: leo)
4) Infra sizing + Dedicated config (owner: carmen)
5) Security review for private deploy (infra/security)
6) Create canary rollout + fallback policy (console + ops)
7) SLA/price proposal to customer

leo: I'll run regression evals after alex posts quant outputs. Can we standardize on 512-token generation config (temp 0.7, top-p 0.95, stop tokens same as BH) so metrics are comparable?

nina: Yes — use temp=0.7, top_p=0.95, max_new_tokens=512, repetition_penalty=1.0.

alex: Taking ownership for quant + perf. I'll update INB-4521 with artifacts and preliminary numbers by EOD. :thumbsup:

carmen: I'll draft Dedicated sizing options and recommended fallback (Lyra-11B) for immediate failover.

sre-bot: Scheduled smoke load test window requested: 2777777830-2777777890. Reply with :ok: to confirm.

nina: Confirmed. Thanks everyone — assigning to owners in the ticket. If blockers pop up (access, tokenizer mismatch, license) ping me.
